title: Can I BEAT Trash Talking Chess Bots?
summary: chess.com's new Trash Talker bots (400 to 2100): Wally Jr (kid whose dad is a 'super duper Grandmaster'), The Hustler (950), Samantha (1300, high-achieving college freshman), Trash Bot 1999 (1700, Y2K computer), and the Master (2100, nice old man who played Spassky). He beats all five, the last with a ladder mate.
rules: Normal chess vs five bots in rising order; each bot sends trash-talk chat lines in response to moves.
